comment: The town ledger — player-driven changes, credited. Served at /council/ledger.json and rendered on the deeds sign. The council appends; entries are never rewritten.

entries.change: The town council convenes: petitions open, the moat is dug, the scales hang
Candyland skin — a spun-sugar wardrobe entry, free from the start
Wardrobe fix — the toast stack no longer covers the skin list's last rows on tablet/desktop widths, so Candyland (and any future last-in-line skin) is selectable
Seed bag now shows each seed's organic sell price alongside its growth time, so a full seed bag reads as a prioritization table, not just an inventory
Harvest all — one button clears every ripe plant in the bed at once, mirroring the existing water-all convenience
